title: Split preparation scan
statement: For every natural number $k$, Boolean words $w,s$, and natural number $j\le |s|$, running the split-preparation machine for $j$ steps from the scan configuration at position $0$ yields the scan configuration at position $j$. At position $j$, the state is $(0, |w|<j)$, the input head is at $\min(j,|w|)+1$, the first work tape stores $s$, each other work tape contains true exactly in cells $j,\ldots,|s|$, every work-tape head is at $j$, and the output is empty.
